audit.description: Changed production code in filestack/utils.py imports FuturesSession from requests_futures.sessions and constructs a FuturesSession-backed RequestsWrapper whose get/post/put/delete calls use the target session and resolve futures with .result(). The diff removes direct production imports of requests and routes changed call sites through filestack.utils.http, while dynamic evidence reports zero source imports from production repo code and target events from filestack/utils.py. There is no evidence of a local fake requests_futures provider; the target origin is under site-packages and target_local_spec_count is 0.
evidence: filestack/utils.py: replaces import requests as original_requests and requests.exceptions.HTTPError with from requests_futures.sessions import FuturesSession
filestack/utils.py: RequestsWrapper.__init__ creates self.session = FuturesSession(); handle_request calls getattr(self.session, name)(...).result()
filestack/mixins/common.py, filestack/models/*.py, and filestack/uploads/*.py: changed requests.get/post/put/delete calls to http.get/post/put/delete imported from filestack.utils
dynamic metrics: first_target_events_from_repo show target_import and FuturesSession attr access in filestack/utils.py line 5
dynamic metrics: target_local_spec_count=0 and requests_futures origin is site-packages/requests_futures/__init__.py
reasons: Changed production call sites route through target-backed http wrapper
No local fake target provider detected
